data.body:
Landed as 6f53d07764 (Gerrit change 1674, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted by RebarBotNava). Gerrit rebased server-side, so the landed sha differs from the locally-committed 8ab856b662; the worktree was realigned onto gerrit/main and the ACs re-verified against the LANDED tree.

Implementation: an optional cap_override threads ProductionBatchRunner.run -> run_pass1 -> sizing.shed_to_budget, defaulting to None (today's behaviour, byte-identical). It is the FINAL cap, used verbatim and NOT centrality-scaled -- that asymmetry is the whole point, since plan_budget_cap reads REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET as the BASE and then scales it, which is why the env var was never a true cap override. Selection is on 'is None' rather than falsiness, so an explicit 0.0 is a real cap ('shed everything sheddable'); a dedicated test pins that trap. coverage.budget gained cap_source (override|computed) so which cap governed a run stays observable, and the runner's journal flipped to budget_override_applied=True with the no-seam WARNING dropped.

Scope honesty: the plan-review gate YAML sets NO usd_budget on its finders batch, so req.usd_budget is None on every live gate run and live behaviour is UNCHANGED. This built the seam only; starting to set a budget is a separate cost-policy decision, and a test pins the current absence so the claim cannot silently rot.

Two findings worth recording. (1) The same monkeypatch-arity trap as the sibling ticket: run_pass1 is stubbed with a 6-positional-arg _fake_run_pass1 in TWO places (test_pass1_finder_model.py and test_model_class_ladder.py), invisible to Serena, found by grepping the symbol as a string; both were updated. (2) The change first FAILED the module-size gate -- pass1.py went 797 -> 801, one line over the 800 hard cap. Caught locally by the full unit suite, not in CI. Fixed by condensing the added docstring; pass1.py lands at 799, so it now has almost no headroom and the next edit there will likely need a split along an existing call-graph seam.

Gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (509 files), full unit suite 9660 passed / 42 skipped after the module-size fix, targeted plan-review + workflow sweep 805 passed.
